content.text:
I added the `/` shortcut. Enter and Escape already worked, so I left that code alone. All six checks pass (the five earlier ones plus a new one for `/`), and none of the earlier features needed a fix.
I went with `/` doing nothing while a text field, dropdown or other editable area has focus, so a `/` typed into a todo, an edit or the search box stays as text; the rule sits above `isTypingTarget` in `todos.js`.
I didn't write a separate Enter handler, because pressing Enter already adds the todo through the form's Add button.
